en: I'll bring up a topic, and you interject with something that fits.
What do you mean, "interject"?
You know, keep the conversation flowin' by saying stuff like, "Is that so?" Your interjections set the pace of the conversation.
That sounds tricky.
No need to overthink it. It's just like a normal conversation, ya see?
And when I say something silly, you hammer it home with some kinda clever retort.
Like, "What the hell're ya thinkin'?"
Ya got natural talent, so I know you'll come up with the wittiest comebacks. Just pick the one ya think works best, and you'll be splittin' sides like a comedy lumberjack.
I'll give it a shot!
That's the spirit! If all goes well, we'll get the crowd and the judges on our side. That's how we're gonna pass.
Amazing! We did it!
My heart was racing! I'm so glad it went well.
I knew you were the real deal. Your timing's great, Haruka-chan.
Now we passed the first round! Time to head back for a rest!
That ain't the best we coulda done.
I know. I'm sorry.
Oh, it ain't your fault, Haruka-chan. I know ya got what it takes to pull this off. We just got unlucky.
Cheer up! We can keep tryin' for this audition as many times as we want.
No point dwellin' on the past. Let's get our act together and give it another shot!
All right, time for one more try. We're gonna kill it this time!
We passed the first audition, so ya got an idea of what to expect now, right?
Yes, but I'm still nervous.
Just do it like before, and we'll cruise through. Looks like we're up next. Let's go.
Sweet! We passed the second round, too! I reckon we're goin' places!
Everyone was laughing so hard! It made me really happy, and I had a ton of fun!
That's the power of laughter. It's all about makin' magic with the crowd.
Once ya get the crowd warmed up, hearing 'em chortlin' away encourages ya, so we can get 'em even more worked up. That interplay is key.
I guess you could say the same about performing songs. It's important to acknowledge the crowd.
Ain't that the truth? Now we're through to the last round. Guess we should head home and get some rest for now.
I know... I'm sorry.
No point lettin' it get to us. We can try this audition as many times as we want, too. Just gotta regroup and give it another shot!
Just keep doin' whatever worked last time. All right, we're up now. Let's do this.
We made it this far, so there's nothin' more to say. We just buckle down and do our best.
Okay. Let's ace this one as well!
All right, looks like we're up now. Let's make 'em laugh like they never have before!
I don't believe it. We actually passed!
Holy takoyaki. I think I'm in shock. I can't even think straight.
I'm kind of stunned, too. This is a first for me. I had no idea we could make it this far!
I gotta say, your perfect timing was probably a big part of it. Never got laughs this big with my old partner.
Oh, don't be silly. This is all thanks to your stellar jokes.
Ya think? Tellin' me things like that's only gonna inflate my ego!
What's eatin' ya, Haruka-chan?
Oh, it's just I'm going to miss this now that it's all over.
I hear ya. Well, every ending is a new beginning, as they say. Let's head out.
We made it this far, so there's nothin' more to say. We just gotta buckle down and do our best.
Welcome. Have you decided what you'd like to order?
Very well. We hope you'll come by again soon.
I'd like the <Color:8>Lamb Rib Eye Barbeque<Color:Default>.
(Guess Kaguya wants the <Color:8>Lamb Rib Eye Barbeque<Color:Default>.)
Bon appetit!
You eat a lot, don't ya?
Looks are deceiving, but I am a big eater. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> You're going to be shocked when we get the bill!
I don't mind. I like watchin' someone enjoy their food. It's fun to have a healthy appetite and even fight over whatever's left on a plate.
Oh, I'm certainly not that greedy. I like to order just one additional dish for myself. That ensures that I get to eat plenty!
If someone's gonna order extra, I'd rather share as much of my dish as I can.
Well, I find it a bit crass to ask someone else to share what they ordered.
Ya do?
And so I offer to share what I've ordered first, and then the other person will share their food with me in return!
Smart move. Rather than come off as beggin', ya come off as pretty generous instead.
Exactly. Then the other person feels like they're giving me back something in exchange for what I gave to them.
It works well almost every time. I highly recommend trying it sometime!
What happens if it doesn't go well?
It happens sometimes. Some clueless people will just say thanks and then not offer anything of their own.
If that happens, I have to ask for some of theirs, and that ruins the whole point of the exercise.
Maybe if ya started by askin' that in the first place, you wouldn't have to share at all.
Ya've got no shame. That's basically the same thing as tellin' the other person to let ya have what they got.
Perhaps, but it's more polite than simply asking for it outright, don't you think?
What a load of bull. If ya pulled that nonsense in Kansai, it'd tick people off.
But don't people from Kyoto have their own incredibly roundabout way of saying things, too?
For instance, isn't asking a guest if they want to have some ochazuke essentially telling them it's about time they went home?
Well, I guess they do that in Kyoto.
See? So it's got nothing to do with Kansai. We Japanese are just like that.
Hm. I dunno...
I don't like beatin' around the bush. If ya wanna eat somethin', come out and say so.
Oh no, I could never! If I want it that much, I'd simply order a plate of it for myself.
Nah, that's just you tryin' to be too polite. If ya want somethin', be up front about it. No one is gonna be upset over it.
I can't do that! I don't want people thinking that I'm greedy whenever it comes to food.
But you are bein' greedy over food, aren't ya? Otherwise you wouldn't be thinkin' of how to get other people to share their food with ya.
That's not it! It's totally normal for girls to share food with their friends.
You really don't understand anything about how girls work, Saejima-san.
Hmph. What a pain in the ass...
Thanks for the food! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Here is your check. Thank you very much.
Sorry, but somethin' came up. I gotta go.
Sorry, I just remembered I have something to do.
Uncle Kaz, I'd really like the <Color:8>Grade-A Lamb Barbeque<Color:Default>.
(Haruka wants to have the <Color:8>Grade-A Lamb Barbeque<Color:Default>.)
Oh. Okay. Maybe I can have the <Color:8>Grade-A Lamb Barbeque<Color:Default> some other time.
Sorry, but something came up. I gotta go.
(Well, maybe I oughta eat somethin' and savor the moment.)
Uncle Kaz! That <Color:8>Gyoza Curry<Color:Default> looks good!
(Hmm. Looks like Haruka wants some <Color:8>Gyoza Curry<Color:Default>.)
Aww, don't you want some <Color:8>Gyoza Curry<Color:Default>?
Thanks, Uncle Kaz! I can't wait to dig in!
Welcome. Please have a seat.
(I'm out of cash.)
That's fine. We await your next visit.
(What should I eat?)
(Hmmm. I wonder what's good?)
(Maybe I should go.)
(Guess I should go.)
(Maybe I oughta go.)
(Should I go?)
(I suppose I ought to go.)
Here's your check.
May I take your order?
I bet the <Color:8>Gyoza<Color:Default> here are good.
(Guess Kaguya wants the <Color:8>Gyoza<Color:Default>.)
Oh, could you pass the chili oil?
You like spicy foods, do ya?
I love them! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> Green curry, dan-dan noodles, kimchi stew... I eat things like that all the time!
Those're pretty darn spicy. Don't ya eat anythin' that's a bit more toned down?
Let me think... Salted squid innards?
Sounds like what an old geezer would order when he's out drinkin'.
I like sweet foods, too. I always keep my refrigerator stocked with chocolate.
Ah, so ya like sweet things and not just spicy. What's up with yer taste buds?
There's nothing particularly special about it. I just like things that taste good.
Yer lucky. It's good to be able to enjoy all kinds a' food.
Lots of men like spicy foods, don't they? Since I'm okay with them too, it makes it easy to decide on a restaurant when going on a date.
I go to plenty of tasty sweet shops when I go out for tea with other girls, so that's fine as well. I'll basically go anywhere!
See, I'm the opposite. I can't handle a trip to the sweet shop all that well.
You don't like sweet foods?
It ain't that. I'm too embarrassed to go to a place filled with nothin' but young ladies.
Saejima-san, that's so adorable! I'll have to bring you with me sometime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I'll pass, thanks.
Did your taste buds go numb? If ya eat too many spicy foods, you mighta lost the ability to tell spicy and sweet apart.
That's not it. I'm something of a gourmet, after all! I have full confidence in my taste buds.
In that case, why not skip the chili oil and enjoy the taste of the ingredients as they are?
That's not a bad idea, but I like the taste of chili oil! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> So why not let myself enjoy that as well?
Heh. Yer like one of those folks that puts mayo on everythin'.
Yes, exactly! I hear that there are a lot of people out there who are crazy about mayonnaise. I'm like the chili oil version of that!
But havin' too much ain't good for your health. Ya need to keep yer seasonings in check.
How about sour things?
Oh, I don't really hate them, but I don't like them all that much either.
Oh yeah? How come?
I don't mind the flavor so much, but I don't know a lot of sour things that are tasty.
Yeah. People do tend to choose other dishes before vinegary foods, like pickles.
Yes, so if there was some definitive dish that showcased vinegar, it might change my mind.
Oh, that's it! Maybe if there were some kind of edible vinegar? That might actually be pretty tasty!
I think they got that already.
(What should I get to eat?)
Uncle Kaz, I'd really like the <Color:8>Shrimp in Chili Sauce<Color:Default>.
(Haruka wants to have the <Color:8>Shrimp in Chili Sauce<Color:Default>.)
But I wanted the <Color:8>Shrimp in Chili Sauce<Color:Default>...
Oh, hello! Right this way, please.
(I'm not hungry.)
(I'm full for now.)
(It's tempting, but I'm stuffed.)
(I'm full.)
Sorry, I have to run.
Sorry, I forgot an urgent piece of business.
Sorry, gotta go.
Oh, sorry! I have to run.
I'm so sorry. Something came up.
All right. Please do come again.
What would you like to eat?
Sorry, just remembered I got something to do first.
Thank you very much. We hope to see you again soon.
(Woohoo! The place is crawling with cuties! What is this place?)
(I'm not hungry at all.)
(Feelin' full.)
(It's too bad, but I'm stuffed already.)
(I feel really full.)
(I'm broke...)
Sorry. Something just came up.
Sorry. Gotta dash.
I'm so sorry. I have something I need to take care of.
Oh, I see. We hope to see you again real soon!
I'll show you to your seat. This way, please.
Hello, I'm Saki! I'll be your server today.
My server, huh? Nice! But wow, Saki-chan, you're really cute. And I like the outfit!
Yes. The costumes are just a small part of our unique dining experience.
Well, well. That's intriguing. So, uh, am I allowed to ask you about your hobbies and chat you up before ordering?
You sure can! My hobby is playing video games. I actually work as an assistant at a game magazine, too.
Cool. You work a lot, huh?
Yeah. Are you into games, too?
Ehh, I used to play before, but not anymore. I'd play way more if I could afford it.
Oh, that's too bad. We could've had a much longer conversation if you were more into games...
(Crap! I should've said I like games just to keep her talking.)
Uh, well, if you're into games, then I gotta check 'em out, yeah?
Great! I'll look forward to hearing about it the next time you come in. Now, what can I get you to drink?
Oh, yeah, my order. Uh...
What can I get you to eat?
This, please.
Great! Thank you very much. I'll get that right out for you.
I'll be back, Saki-chan!
Thanks so much! We'll be waiting for you!
Sorry. I don't need anything today after all.
Oh... That's too bad. Please come back anytime.
Hi, Saki-chan! I'm back.
Have you decided what you're having?
Here is your bill. Thank you very much.
I'm so sorry. I have to attend an urgent matter.
Thank you very much. We hope to see you again.
